p.src: 2  “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

en: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
u.src: 2  “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

p.src: 3  How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

ja: 言し、 確かな知識を豊かに宣
en: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
u.src: 3  How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

p.src: 4  To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

en: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
u.src: 4  To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

p.src: 5  “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

ja: える。 水の下にいる者たちも、そこに住むすべてのものも。
en: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
u.src: 5  “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

p.src: 6  Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

ja: であり、 アバドン には何の
en: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
u.src: 6  Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

ja:
26:6 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
26:6 アバドンは滅ぼす者を意味する。
en:
26:6 Sheol is the place of the dead.
26:6 Abaddon means Destroyer.

p.src: 7  He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

en: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
u.src: 7  He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

p.src: 8  He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

ja: み込まれるが、 雲はその
en: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
u.src: 8  He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

p.src: 9  He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

en: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
u.src: 9  He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

p.src: 10  He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

ja: 界を引き、 光と暗闇の果てまでを
en: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
u.src: 10  He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

p.src: 11  The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
u.src: 11  The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

p.src: 12  He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

ja: をかき立て、 その英
en: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
u.src: 12  He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

p.src: 13  By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

en: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
u.src: 13  By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

p.src: 14  Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

ja: さなささやきだろうか。 しかし、神の
を誰が理解できようか。
en: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
